Team — attaching v3 of the investor slide deck and a focused run-of-show (ROF) doc. QBR is scheduled for Oct 6; investors get the deck on Oct 1. Requesting a short review cycle so we lock by end of Friday (Sep 24).

Key asks:
- Jonas: please validate the product roadmap slide and add any major dependencies (one-line).
- Marissa: confirm the revenue heatmap and attach any outstanding tables to the data appendix.
- Laura: legal check on the new customer logos slide (we added two enterprise logos; we need permission flags).
- Tessa: can you own the final review pass for messaging and the opening remarks?

Attached: 2026_Q3_board_draft_v3.pptx, run_of_show_v2.docx, data_appendix_q3.csv

Run-of-show highlights (from the doc):
- 00:00 — Welcome / agenda (CEO)
- 03:00 — Market & ops highlights (CRO)
- 08:00 — Product roadmap & investments (CTO)
- 18:00 — GTM/metrics deep dive (Head of Rev)
- 30:00 — Q&A and closes

If you can't hit the Friday lock, call out blockers now so we can escalate. I'll consolidate comments and send to Board Secretariat for investor distribution.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor

Neha — quick pass, thanks for pulling this together. Inline notes below (copied into deck comments):
- Slide 12 (Roadmap): add a one-line dependency to "quantization tooling" and note expected completion by EOY — I will update slide text.
- Slide 15 (Latency benchmarks): can we collapse the table to key slices? it's dense for the investor packet — propose 3 buckets (p95 small, p50 medium, avg token cost).

Also: recommend a 90-second demo clip instead of a live demo for the call — reduces risk and keeps timing predictable.

I'll add my updates by EOD.

— Jonas
